project: STAR INK — Anatomically Strict Ballerina Blueprint (Arte01)
philosophy: Saint-Exupery Subtraction Aesthetics & Anatomical Precision (Exactly 2 Arms, 2 Legs)

reference_image.instructions: STRICT ANATOMY TRANSFER: Exactly TWO human arms (left arm holding front edge of silk fabric, right arm holding top edge of silk fabric). Exactly TWO legs.

master_structure.goal: Generate a high-precision white fine-line vector drawing of the ballerina from Bailarina.png on a pure black background (#000000). STRICT REQUIREMENT: Anatomically perfect human body with EXACTLY two arms, two hands, two legs, and two feet.

secondary: fine-line white vector drawing on black

main_subject.pose: MATCH Bailarina.png: standing en pointe on ONE supporting leg, lifted leg extended behind in elegant high attitude, torso arched back
main_subject.arms_and_hands: Left arm extending forward holding the silk fabric corner. Right arm reaching up-right holding the top silk fabric corner. NO THIRD ARM.
main_subject.fabric_element: a single sweeping translucent silk fabric sheet flowing in a grand arch behind the ballerina

lighting.environment: flat 2D line drawing on pure black background (#000000)
lighting.key_light: pure crisp white (#ffffff) fine line-art stroke contours

linework.style: clean wispy silk contour line art
linework.thickness: hairline ultra-thin 1px strokes for body and 0.5px overlapping lines for translucent silk veil
linework.quality: feather-light, fluid, high-fashion hand-drawn vector precision
